name: interval-tree
description: Augmented BST that stores intervals and supports efficient overlap and point-stab queries.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to find all intervals that overlap a given point or range, such as calendar conflict detection, genomics annotation overlap, or network packet scheduling.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The start (left endpoint) of an interval to insert.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The end (right endpoint) of an interval to insert.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Optional arbitrary payload to associate with the interval.
